$comment: Everything one grader runner holds constant. A grader is chosen when grading runs, not when a batch's authors run, so nothing here is part of a batch's input digest; a grading session records the block it ran under. The version pins are exact and grading refuses a mismatch; `bun run eval:skill pin` rewrites them from the executables on PATH.

codex.sessions: one per grading session, resumed rather than recreated (codex exec resume <thread>)
codex.images: attached with --image on every call, including a resumed one
codex.usageSemantics: cumulative: turn.completed carries the thread's total_token_usage, so a call's own usage is the growth since the previous reading and a session costs its last reading, never the sum of its calls. cached_input_tokens is a subset of input_tokens; total = input + output. Verified without a model from the retained rollout of the 2026-09-14 batch (docs/design/skill-evals/2026-09-14-batch-corrections.md).
codex.reads: workspace only: a command naming a path outside graders/workspace, or a file change landing outside it, files the call as an error and discards its answer (the sandbox blocks writes, not reads)

claude.sessions: one per grading session, started with --session-id and continued with --resume
claude.subagents: unreachable: the Agent tool is not in the tool list, and the prompt forbids delegation
claude.images: read by the grader from the staged workspace with its Read tool; the harness records which files the stream shows were opened
claude.usageSemantics: per call: the result line's usage is this call's own, so a session costs the sum of its calls. input_tokens is uncached input; cache_read_input_tokens and cache_creation_input_tokens are separate, so the normalized input is their sum and cached is cache reads. total_cost_usd and modelUsage are kept raw beside the normalized usage. Verified on claude 2.1.269 with a resumed probe session on 2026-09-15.
